summary: Easy-Wi provides a web-based control panel for managing various server daemons, with a primary focus on game servers. It also includes an integrated content management system featuring a rental and lending service for voice and game servers.
goodFor: Administrators who want to run a hosted rental service for multiplayer game and voice servers through a single web interface.
watchOut: The project exhibits low maintenance activity, suggesting potential security and compatibility issues over time.
deployNotes: As a PHP and shell-based application, it typically requires a standard web server stack with a database and sufficient permissions to execute management scripts.
